_comment: Context-Hub MCP configuration for AI-PM (Claude Desktop / Claude Code) integration.
_description: AI-PM connects to Context-Hub over MCP stdio to answer questions about your project context (issues, documents, meetings) without sending raw data to external services.
_auth_note: MCP stdio auth is not enforced in v0.1.0 (localhost-only operation). CONTEXT_HUB_API_KEY is NOT required and will be ignored. Full auth (bcrypt + ConsumerRepository) will be added in v0.2.0.
